about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Who I Am
about.body: I am a result-driven professional with a strong foundation in Project Management and a specialization in Vibe Coder methodology. I thrive at the intersection of operations, technology, and strategy — bridging teams, streamlining processes, and driving measurable outcomes. With experience spanning startups, international NGOs, and government institutions, I bring adaptability, cross-cultural communication, and a continuous improvement mindset to every role. I believe the future belongs to those who can connect domain expertise with emerging technology, and I am committed to being at that frontier.

experience.subtitle: My Professional Journey
exp.0.desc: Conduct field visits to assess customer needs. Monitor daily activities on the TREEO cloud. Enhance UI/UX design of TREEO Apps. Provide training and user documentation.
exp.1.desc: Managed daily operations with 5 Tree Planting Partners. Planned and tracked tree-planting programs. Served as main contact for TPPs. Monitored data quality and reporting.
exp.2.desc: Managed relationships with tree-planting partners. Conducted field visits to evaluate user experience. Coordinated with the global Technology team. Delivered training and user documentation.
exp.3.desc: Conducted field visits assessing TREEO technology user experience. Monitored daily activities on TREEO cloud. Enhanced UI/UX of TREEO Apps. Provided comprehensive user support and training.
exp.4.desc: Developed and shipped Android applications using Kotlin and Java in Android Studio. Designed wireframes and high-fidelity mockups for mobile and web applications. Collaborated with stakeholders to translate business requirements into intuitive user interfaces.
exp.5.desc: Prepared data flow and safety materials. Managed data collection and processing. Ensured safety procedures compliance across all staff.
exp.6.desc: Managed office contracts and asset handovers. Coordinated security and driver operations. Maintained fleet of four vehicles. Tracked all company assets.
exp.7.desc: Handled B2B communication. Demonstrated Quick Tractor product to oil palm plantations across Sumatra, Sulawesi, and Borneo.
exp.8.desc: Designed the cover for the annual census publication. Created posters and vector graphics to support the publication.
